pe_ttm.notes: Recalculated using current market cap and saved net_income in the listing currency.

price_to_sales_ttm.notes: Recalculated using current market cap and saved revenue in the listing currency.

forward_pe_proxy.notes: forward_pe_proxy: Positive 3-year EPS CAGR or trailing EPS was unavailable; forward P/E proxy is not meaningful.

forward_pe_public_estimate.notes: Current price divided by saved expected EPS from Yahoo or its implied forward P/E input; not an SEC fact.

peg_proxy.notes: peg: Positive 3-year EPS CAGR was unavailable; PEG is not meaningful.

eps_growth_3y_proxy.notes: eps_cagr_3y: EPS turned positive from a loss-making comparison period (latest 0.33, comparison -0.24); 3-year EPS CAGR is not meaningful.

ev_to_ebitda_proxy.notes: Current enterprise value divided by saved EBITDA in the listing currency.

eps_gaap_growth_yoy.notes: Latest-quarter diluted EPS YoY growth computed from comparable SEC quarterly diluted EPS facts.

days_to_next_earnings.notes: Days until the next expected earnings release window (2026-12-01) from Yahoo Finance/yfinance. This is an open/free market-calendar estimate and can change before the company confirms the date.

enterprise_value_proxy.notes: Current market cap plus saved debt minus saved cash in the listing currency.

fcf_margin_ttm.notes: Free cash flow TTM divided by revenue TTM, expressed as a percentage.

fcf_margin.notes: Free cash flow TTM divided by revenue TTM, expressed as a percentage.
